purpose: Multi-agent orchestration platform running Claude sessions as Kubernetes pods with Kafka-based job distribution

domain_model.description: A registry of agents, skills, guards, and resources that defines the system's capability surface and access control rules
relationships: guards validate tool operations via agent auth
jobs are routed to agents via Kafka topics
memory entries are scoped to global or project
resources are cached and served by owning agents

bounded_contexts.name: Agent Runtime
bounded_contexts.description: Manages Claude session lifecycle, job consumption, and memory persistence per agent pod

ubiquitous_language.job: A Kafka message containing a prompt and metadata, consumed by an agent pod
ubiquitous_language.reflection: Post-job memory persistence prompt injected after successful completion
ubiquitous_language.preflight: Optional validation script run before job execution

bounded_contexts.name: Job Routing
bounded_contexts.description: Publishes jobs to agent topics, serves MCP tools, manages caching and resource registry

ubiquitous_language.route: A KORD.json skill entry that maps to a Kafka topic and optional cache
ubiquitous_language.delegate: Submit a job to an agent and wait for result

bounded_contexts.name: Platform Operations
bounded_contexts.description: Bootstrap, deploy, scale, and monitor the agent cluster

ubiquitous_language.bootstrap: Initial cluster setup from bare metal to running agent pods
ubiquitous_language.wrap: Add deployment manifests and monitoring to a project

stack.runtime: Node.js 22 services running as Kubernetes pods on k3s, with Claude Code CLI as subprocess per agent pod. KEDA scales agent pods 0-3 on Kafka consumer lag.

groups.name: Agent Platform
groups.description: Core runtime services that manage agent lifecycle, job distribution, and memory persistence

groups.name: Agent Team
groups.description: Five specialized agents providing architecture, infrastructure, monitoring, config, and security capabilities

groups.name: Infrastructure
groups.description: Cluster bootstrap, session management, and deployment tooling

actors.description: Human user interacting via workstation pod and tmux sessions
Sends push webhook events that trigger agent jobs

components.name: Agent Pod Daemon
components.description: Long-lived bridge that spawns a persistent Claude CLI process, consumes jobs from Kafka, and manages memory change detection

components.name: Agent Scribe
components.description: Consumes memory update events from Kafka, deduplicates via Claude Haiku, and persists to agent memory directories

components.name: Job Router
components.description: HTTP/MCP gateway that loads skill registry from KORD.json, publishes jobs to Kafka, manages response correlation, and serves cached resources

components.name: Webhook Receiver
components.description: GitHub push-event gateway that verifies HMAC signatures, applies gate filters, and delegates dependency-change jobs to agents

components.name: Augur Agent
components.description: Architecture review and pattern authority — analyzes project structure, detects patterns, assesses debt, and composes stories

components.name: Charon Agent
components.description: Infrastructure operations — bootstraps clusters, deploys services, manages nodes, wraps projects for deployment

components.name: Sauron Agent
components.description: Monitoring and observability — scans for signals, diagnoses issues, designs and implements monitoring systems

components.name: Alfred Agent
components.description: Configuration and credential management — retrieves and stores config, credentials, and kustomize overlays

components.name: Warden Agent
components.description: Security scanning and output validation — scans for secrets, validates agent output, classifies content

components.name: Bootstrap CLI
components.description: Cluster initialization tool — installs k3s, deploys workstation pod, sets up auth and networking

components.name: Session Manager
components.description: Tmux-based session isolation using git worktrees with parallel memory branches per session

components.name: Guard System
components.description: Data-driven access control via KORD.json guards, PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks, and auth lock files

flows.name: Job Execution Pipeline
flows.description: A job is submitted via HTTP/MCP, published to Kafka, consumed by an agent pod, executed by Claude, and the result returned
flows.trigger: HTTP POST to /api/delegate or MCP delegate tool call

steps.data: job JSON with prompt, agent, correlation_id

steps.action: consumes job, runs preflight, injects memory context
Claude processes prompt and produces result
correlates result and returns to caller

flows.name: Memory Persistence Pipeline
flows.description: Agents post memory updates via HTTP, which are queued in Kafka, batched, deduplicated by Haiku, and written to the filesystem
flows.trigger: Agent calls POST /memory-update during or after job execution

steps.action: receives memory update HTTP POST from Claude process
batches updates (30s window), deduplicates via Haiku API
writes merged content to memory directory

flows.name: Webhook CI Pipeline
flows.description: GitHub push events are filtered through gates and dependency-change pushes trigger agent jobs
flows.trigger: GitHub push webhook to main branch

steps.action: delegates to charon agent via job-router

flows.name: Guard Enforcement Chain
flows.description: PreToolUse hooks validate operations against KORD.json guards, checking auth locks and file ownership
flows.trigger: Claude attempts a Write, Edit, Bash, or MCP tool call

steps.action: validates auth lock file matches profile lock

cascade.effect: Cannot publish jobs or receive results; all delegation calls timeout
Cannot consume new jobs or publish results
Memory updates queue in-flight but cannot be consumed

failure_modes.impact: Complete platform halt — no agent jobs can be submitted or completed
detection: Kafka connection retry logs in all services
KEDA unable to query consumer lag
recovery: Messages are durable — will be consumed on recovery

cascade.effect: Current job fails with error; daemon respawns Claude after 3s delay

failure_modes.impact: Single job failure; subsequent jobs process normally after respawn
recovery: Automatic: daemon respawns Claude process after 3s

failure_modes.trigger: Anthropic Haiku API returns error or is unavailable

cascade.effect: Deduplication bypassed — all content appended without filtering

failure_modes.impact: Memory files grow with duplicate entries; no data loss but degraded quality
recovery: Manual: re-run deduplication when API recovers

cascade.effect: Job marked as timeout, error published to jobs.result

failure_modes.impact: Single job failure; caller receives timeout error
recovery: Manual: resubmit job or increase timeout

failure_modes.trigger: Longhorn PVC runs out of space (agent-runtime or kord PVC)

cascade.effect: Cannot write memory updates; filesystem errors
Cannot clone repos or write temp files

failure_modes.impact: Agent jobs fail on write; memory updates lost

cascade.effect: Accepts all webhook payloads without signature verification

failure_modes.impact: Unauthorized webhook submissions could trigger unwanted agent jobs
detection: Log: 'WEBHOOK_SECRET not set — accepting unsigned webhooks'

evidence.note: All core services use KafkaJS producer/consumer for job distribution and memory updates
Job-router adapts HTTP/MCP to Kafka; daemon adapts Kafka to Claude stdin/stdout; webhook-receiver adapts GitHub to job-router
Express + MCP server with route registry, dynamic tool registration, and caching
correlation_id generated per job for request-response tracing across Kafka topics
All services emit JSON logs with level, agent, job_id, correlation_id, event, timestamp
All HTTP services expose /health endpoints for K8s readiness/liveness probes
File-based cache with ETag, TTL, hash-based invalidation, and threshold-based freshness scoring
Webhook gates (branch, docs, cooldown, deps) and hook chain (memory-intercept → kord-guard) process sequentially
Alfred manages config.yaml, overlays, and credentials via pass store with validation
All K8s resources in YAML manifests, Kustomize overlays for environment differentiation, KEDA ScaledObjects
Scribe batches memory updates in a 30-second window before processing
HMAC webhook verification and file-based auth lock system for guarded operations
Zod schemas for MCP parameters, agent name regex validation, KORD.json pattern matching
KEDA scales 0-3 agent pods per topic; multiple pods in same consumer group compete for messages
Kafka broker URL, job-router URL, and Claude model names hardcoded as defaults (overridable via env vars)

gaps.relevance: Kafka has retry but Claude API calls and webhook delegation have no retry logic
gaps.recommendation: Add exponential backoff retry for Haiku dedup calls and webhook-to-router delegation

gaps.relevance: Job-router /api/delegate has no rate limiting on unauthenticated endpoint
gaps.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware to Express routes, especially /api/delegate

gaps.relevance: Correlation IDs exist but no OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing spans
gaps.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry to connect Kafka, HTTP, and Claude processing spans

gaps.relevance: Kafka consumer pauses during job processing but no explicit backpressure mechanism for memory updates or job submission rate
gaps.recommendation: Add explicit backpressure signaling when agent pods are saturated

No API versioning — all routes served at root path
No global error handler or shared error schema — errors returned as ad-hoc JSON

violations.anti_pattern: No default-deny auth on API endpoints
violations.detail: All endpoints except /webhook are unauthenticated — any pod in the cluster can submit jobs or read status

violations.anti_pattern: No circuit breaker on external API calls
violations.detail: Haiku API calls for deduplication have no circuit breaker — repeated failures cause latency spikes

violations.anti_pattern: Webhook delegation has no retry or timeout
violations.detail: HTTP fetch to job-router has no retry, timeout, or fallback — transient failures drop webhook events

violations.anti_pattern: No rate limiting on public endpoints
violations.detail: POST /api/delegate accepts unlimited requests — could be used to saturate agent pods

violations.anti_pattern: Webhook secret allows unsigned payloads when unset
violations.detail: Missing WEBHOOK_SECRET env var silently disables signature verification instead of failing closed
Route handlers contain inline Kafka operations, cache logic, and response assembly — no service layer
Handlers import kafkajs, child_process, and fs directly instead of through abstractions

violations.anti_pattern: No test framework or test suite
violations.detail: No unit or integration tests exist for any core runtime module

violations.anti_pattern: No linting or code formatting configured
violations.detail: No ESLint, Prettier, or other linting tools configured for JavaScript source
Cooldown map and result buffer grow unbounded — no LRU eviction or size limit
Kafka broker URLs and service endpoints hardcoded as fallback defaults

recommendations.title: Add authentication to internal API endpoints
recommendations.description: Add a default-deny auth middleware (e.g., shared secret or mTLS) to job-router and daemon status endpoints. Even cluster-internal services benefit from auth to prevent lateral movement if a pod is compromised.
fixes: No default-deny auth on API endpoints

recommendations.title: Add resilience wrappers for external calls
recommendations.description: Wrap Haiku API calls and webhook-to-router delegation with retry (exponential backoff) and circuit breaker. The scribe already has a fallback — add retry before falling back. The webhook receiver should retry once before dropping the event.
fixes: No circuit breaker on external API calls
Webhook delegation has no retry or timeout

recommendations.title: Add rate limiting to public endpoints
recommendations.description: Add Express rate limiting middleware (e.g., express-rate-limit) to /api/delegate and /mcp endpoints. Even modest limits (e.g., 10 req/s per source IP) prevent accidental or malicious flood.
fixes: No rate limiting on public endpoints

recommendations.title: Fail closed when webhook secret is missing
recommendations.description: Change the missing WEBHOOK_SECRET behavior from 'accept all' to 'reject all'. This prevents unauthorized webhook submissions in misconfigured deployments.
fixes: Webhook secret allows unsigned payloads when unset

recommendations.title: Add test framework and core tests
recommendations.description: Add Jest or Vitest with unit tests for job correlation logic, cache scoring, webhook gate filtering, and memory dedup routing. These are the highest-value test targets for preventing regressions.
fixes: No test framework or test suite
No linting or code formatting configured
